name: Secure Electronic Technology PLC
source: Secure Electronic Technology Plc, NGX ticker NSLTECH and also listed by the board as SET Plc. Audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, held in the NGX disclosure library. The filing is a scan with no text layer, so every figure was read from it by OCR at 200 dpi on 25 September 2026, and each printed identity was checked before the rows were written

rows.label: Non-current Assets
rows.note: property plant and equipment 1,063,427,760 plus intangible assets 2,239,600,000 plus deferred tax 995,221,000; FY2024 is 1,118,491,671 plus 2,492,366,667 plus 995,221,000

rows.label: Current Assets
rows.note: trade and other receivables 128,755,900 plus prepayments 466,667 plus cash and cash equivalents 20,510,357; FY2024 is 170,628,408 plus 8,200,000 plus 52,655,645

rows.label: Non-current Liabilities
rows.note: the printed borrowing line, unchanged between the two years

rows.label: Current Liabilities
rows.note: trade and other payables 19,749,969 plus current tax payable 522,158,768; FY2024 is 74,078,378 plus a short term bank loan of 20,000,000 plus 522,158,768

rows.label: Total Equity
rows.note: as printed on the statement of financial position; the statement of changes in equity in the same filing shows 3,841,757,265 at 1 January 2025, a restatement of the accumulated loss split of 68,919,203 that the two statements present differently

note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer, statement of financial position page 19. Every row is a printed figure and three identities tie in both years: non-current plus current assets equals total assets, non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities, and total assets equals total liabilities plus total equity. Figures are in naira, stored absolute. The component notes were cross checked against the working capital movements on the statement of cash flows, which reproduce the same year on year changes to the naira. This replaced an interim file that carried the HY 2026 cash line with the total assets, total liabilities and total equity rows empty; that file is in the backup directory named in the audit log.
